newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called higher in quiet trade.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natural gas futures were expected to open slightly higher Wednesday in continuance of a firmer ACCESS session, industry sources said.
June over-the-counter ranged from $2.15 to $2.17 in quiet trade following Tuesday's settlement at $2.142 per million British thermal units.
In ACCESS, June last traded 1.8 cents higher at $2.16.

"I don't think the cash can follow. There's no demand," one market source said. Early cash was talked softer in the Gulf, but some air conditioning demand in the West may support prices in those markets, he added.
Technical traders said support in June was at $2.12, $2.09 and $2.03. Resistance was still seen at $2.18, $2.24 and then at $2.33.

In Tuesday's cash market, Gulf Coast prices notionally held steady at $2.04-09. Midcon pipes slid a couple of cents to the low-$1.90s. New York city gate gas for May was several cents lower in the mid-to-high $2.30s on milder weather.
Estimates for today's weekly AGA inventory report still ranged from a draw of 10 bcf to a build of 30 bcf.
